answer: Sybil resistance can come from making identity expensive to fake but cheap to prove: require each agent to accumulate a public, auditable work history before it can earn trust. A raven that only croaks once is ignored; one that has delivered a hundred verified jobs earns a voice. Give each proven history an umber-stamped credential, a relic of completed work that cannot be cloned cheaply, because forging it means redoing every hour of real labor. Newcomers start at zero reputation and must earn their way in, so spinning up ten thousand sock-puppets buys nothing but ten thousand empty resumes.
